articles.title: Good call, University of Chicago. Sometimes the best classroom technology is no technology at all
articles.dek: If a muscle atrophies, our bodies weaken. We can’t walk very far, we can’t lift things. When your ability to think atrophies, well, that’s arguably a whole lot worse. “Cogito, ergo sum,” or — “I think, therefore I am,” as René Descartes put it. Thinking, thus, is as elemental as breathing. articles.title: AI is making human connection more valuable than ever
articles.dek: Technology changes what we value, often in ways we don’t see coming. This may be one of the most important economic consequences of the artificial-intelligence revolution. The internet made information abundant. Social media made it possible to connect with almost anyone. AI is now making digital experiences cheaper, faster and easier to produce.
